purpose: Audit and harden the MAF 1.6 upgrade so CanDoItAll actually uses MAF 1.6 advantages, then close remaining process-runtime risks before real live tests.
primaryConcerns: MAF packages are upgraded, but core agent factory still looks very close to the pre-upgrade adapter and may not use 1.6 features.
Need explicit adoption plan for IChatMessageInjector, AgentSessionFiles, file store, workflow evaluation expected output, A2A v1, tool approval/session semantics, and OpenTelemetry auto-wiring.
Process artifact validation is stronger, but still needs real live-run proof and regression tests around content hash, org-scoped paths, current-run lineage, and satisfaction/finalizer parity.
Need a MAF 1.6 capability matrix and real process-run smoke tests, not only build and mock harness tests.
